entries.text: Okay so today I woke up late again, kind of annoyed at myself. I need to call mom tomorrow evening about Diwali plans. Also I really want to get better at cooking, I keep ordering Swiggy. Felt pretty tired after the gym.
remind me to call mom tomorrow at 6 and I need to buy milk, also felt tired today

um so work was crazy today the client meeting went on for like three hours and honestly I was drained but it went well I think. I have to send the proposal to Rohan by Friday. and I want to start learning Python properly this time
Long term I really want to buy a house in Chandigarh before I turn 35. For now I should save more every month. Today I spent way too much on clothes.
Had a good chat with Simran tonight. She's thinking of moving to Toronto. Made me think, someday I want to live abroad for a few years too.
dentist appointment day after tomorrow at 11 don't let me forget. also pay the electricity bill today
I've been practicing guitar for like twenty minutes every night and it's actually getting easier. My fingers don't hurt as much. I want to be able to play a full song for Priya's birthday.
Note to self, renew the car insurance before the end of the month. And book the Goa tickets this weekend before prices go up.
Feeling a bit low today. Nothing specific, just tired. Maybe I need more sleep. The weather is gloomy too.
My goal this year is to run a half marathon. I'm going to start with 5k runs three times a week. Need to buy proper running shoes this weekend.
so in the meeting today my manager said I need to work on my presentation skills, which is fair I guess. I get nervous. I should practice presenting in front of the mirror.
Call the plumber in 2 hours, the kitchen sink is leaking again. Ugh.
Grateful for my family today. Dad's health is much better. We had dinner together and laughed a lot.
I gotta reply to Arjun's email about the contract and also review the slides for Thursday's demo tonight
One day I'd love to start my own design studio. I think I'm good at it. For that I need to get better at client communication and pricing.
pick up the kids from school at 3 then groceries, we need eggs bread and atta
Watched a really good documentary on space tonight. I want to learn more about astronomy, maybe get a telescope someday.
Remember to transfer rent to the landlord on the 1st. And message the society secretary about the parking.
I'm trying to meditate every morning, did ten minutes today. It helps with the anxiety.
Tomorrow morning I have to drop the car at the service center. Then work from the cafe.
Honestly I want to be financially independent by 40. That's the big one. I need to start investing in index funds, and learn how taxes work.
had lunch with the team, the new guy Kabir seems nice. traffic on the way back was horrible
need to email the HR about leave next week and ask Neha for the report
I've been learning Punjabi script with my nani, it's fun. I'd like to be able to read her old letters.
Book a doctor's appointment for mom this Friday. Her back pain is getting worse.
So yeah the gym was good today, did legs. My goal is to deadlift 100 kg by March.
Don't forget to water the plants before leaving tonight and lock the balcony door
I want to read more books. Like one a month at least. Currently halfway through Atomic Habits.
Submit the GST return by the 25th, accountant reminded me. Also call Ravi uncle after work
It rained all day and I just stayed in and watched Netflix. Pretty lazy but I needed it.
Eventually I want to move into product management. I should talk to Meera about how she made the switch.
I'm getting better at saying no to extra work. Proud of that. Still need to improve my time management though.
cancel the Netflix subscription and order a birthday cake for Anaya for Saturday
Fought with my brother over something stupid. I should apologize to him tomorrow.
within five years I want to have my own house and a dog. Big dreams lol
Interview with Infosys next Monday at 2 pm. I need to prepare system design questions and revise SQL.
The sunset from the terrace was beautiful. Took some photos. I want to get into photography seriously.
Need to fix the wifi router, it keeps disconnecting. Maybe call Airtel support in the afternoon.
Took a typing test today, 55 words per minute. Want to get it to 80.
Meeting with the bank at 10:30 tomorrow about the loan, carry the documents
